title: Workers’ federation calls for State-wide protest against labour codes

ai.summary: The Unorganised Workers’ Federation (UWF) organised a meeting in Thoothukudi to call for state-wide protests on November 26 against Tamil Nadu's labour codes, urging the state government to pass a resolution opposing the codes which unions say weaken job security and workers' rights.

facts.claim: The Unorganised Workers’ Federation (UWF) organised a meeting in Thoothukudi to call for state-wide protests on November 26 against Tamil Nadu's labour codes
facts.quote: A southern regional consultation meeting organised by the Unorganised Workers’ Federation (UWF) was held in Thoothukudi on Friday. The meeting resolved to organise State-wide protests on November 26, urging the State government to pass a resolution opposing the labour codes introduced by the union government.

facts.claim: The meeting resolved to organise State-wide protest at the district headquarters on November 26, urging the Tamil Nadu government to pass a resolution in the legislative Assembly opposing the four labour codes
facts.quote: The meeting resolved to organise State-wide protest at the district headquarters on November 26, urging the Tamil Nadu government to pass a resolution in the legislative Assembly opposing the four labour codes introduced by the union government.

facts.claim: Trade union representatives, office bearers of workers’ organisations and representatives of workers from various sectors in Thoothukudi, Tirunelveli, Kanniyakumari and Tenkasi districts participated in the meeting
facts.quote: Trade union representatives, office bearers of workers’ organisations and representatives of workers from various sectors in Thoothukudi, Tirunelveli, Kanniyakumari and Tenkasi districts participated in the meeting.

facts.claim: The participants discussed the potential impact of the four labour codes introduced by the union government on workers’ rights, job security, social security and trade union rights
facts.quote: The participants discussed the potential impact of the four labour codes introduced by the union government on workers’ rights, job security, social security and trade union rights.

facts.claim: They also expressed concern that the welfare boards functioning under the Tamil Nadu Manual Workers Act could face the risk of being dismantled following the implementation of labour codes
facts.quote: They also expressed concern that the welfare boards functioning under the Tamil Nadu Manual Workers Act could face the risk of being dismantled following the implementation of labour codes.

ai.background_note: The labour codes were introduced by the Centre in November 2025, which unions say weaken job security and workers' rights, leading to nationwide protests.
